findings.summary: The table calls GET, PUT and DELETE "safe", but in HTTP "safe" means read-only, and PUT and DELETE are idempotent, not safe.
findings.evidence: GET, PUT, DELETE | safe: same state
findings.fix: Relabel the row "idempotent: repeat leaves the same state" and the POST row "not idempotent: duplicate side effects".

findings.summary: The rule "Never retry 4xx" contradicts the retryable list in the previous bullet, which includes 429 (a 4xx), and it ignores 408.
findings.evidence: Retry transient failures: timeout, 429, 502, 503, 504 / Never retry 4xx like 400, 401, 404: they fail again
findings.fix: Say "Never retry client-error 4xx such as 400, 401, 404 (except 408 and 429)".
